name: Abigale
description: Abigale is a deaf owlin Strixhaven student and poet who signs and uses a hearing aid that transmits speech telepathically, later a Silverquill College poet.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.
